questions.question: On this day in 1377, Tvrtko I was crowned as the first king of which realm?
questions.explanation: Stephen Tvrtko I of the Kotromanić dynasty, having previously ruled as ban, was crowned the inaugural monarch of Bosnia on 26 October 1377.
questions.context:
On this day in 1377: Tvrtko I is crowned the first king of Bosnia.
Tvrtko I of Bosnia (First king of Bosnia from 1377 to 1391): Stephen Tvrtko I was the first king of Bosnia. A member of the House of Kotromanić, he succeeded his uncle Stephen II as the ban of Bosnia in 1353. As he was a minor at the time, Tvrtko's father, Vladislav, briefly ruled as regent, followed by Tvrtko's mother, Jelena.

questions.question: In the pilot episode of Star Trek: The Original Series, which actress became the first to portray an Orion on screen as the character Vina?
questions.explanation: Susan Oliver played Vina, the green-skinned alien appearing in the pilot episode 'The Cage', though Majel Barrett had earlier completed makeup screen tests.
questions.context: Orion (Star Trek) (Fictional alien race): The Orions are a fictional extraterrestrial humanoid species in the American science fiction franchise Star Trek, making their first appearance in the initial pilot for Star Trek: The Original Series, "The Cage". Susan Oliver portrayed the first Orion seen on screen, when her human character Vina was transformed into one, although it was Majel Barrett who underwent the original makeup test. The footage was subsequently used in the two-part episode "The Menagerie".

questions.question: Before securing a record deal and launching his debut EP Broken Memories, singer Jamie Miller placed third on which UK talent contest in 2017?
questions.explanation: Welsh vocalist Jamie Miller reached the final of The Voice UK in 2017 before releasing his debut musical project in 2022.
questions.context: Jamie Miller (singer) (Welsh singer-songwriter (born 1997)): Jamie Miller is a Welsh singer-songwriter from Cardiff, currently based in Los Angeles. He first gained recognition as a finalist on The Voice UK in 2017, where he finished in third place. Known for his blend of pop and R&B influences, Miller signed with Atlantic Records in 2020 and released his debut EP, Broken Memories, in April 2022. His music, often praised for its emotional depth and powerful vocal delivery, has earned him a growing international fanbase.

questions.question: South African supermodel Candice Swanepoel is particularly celebrated for her long-standing work with which major fashion label?
questions.explanation: Candice Swanepoel rose to worldwide prominence as an official Victoria's Secret Angel, a role she assumed in 2010.
questions.context: Candice Swanepoel (South African model (born 1988)): Candice Susan Swanepoel is a South African model. She is best known for her work with Victoria's Secret. She became a Victoria's Secret Angel in 2010. In 2016, she was listed 8th on the Forbes top-earning models list.

questions.question: Alexander Volkanovski made sporting history as the first fighter born in Australia to claim a championship title in which organisation?
questions.explanation: Volkanovski became the inaugural Australian-born athlete to capture a title in the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), where he reigned in the featherweight division.
questions.context: Alexander Volkanovski (Australian mixed martial artist (born 1988)): Alexander Volkanovski is an Australian professional mixed martial artist. He currently competes in the Featherweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), where he is the current and two-time UFC Featherweight Champion. Volkanovski is the first Australian-born fighter to win a UFC title. He is also a former Australian Fighting Championship (AFC) Featherweight champion. Prior to his UFC debut, Volkanovski competed as a professional boxer in 2015.
